one_liner: Nifty 50 rises 0.38% amid mixed global cues and strong FII inflows.

drivers.title: Nifty 50 Gains
drivers.detail: Nifty 50 rose by 0.38% to close at 25,387.40.

drivers.title: Mixed Global Cues
drivers.detail: Global markets showed mixed performance with US indices declining.

drivers.title: Strong FII Inflows
drivers.detail: FII net inflows were Rs 4,195.38 Cr.

flows_line: FII net inflow of Rs 4,195.38 Cr; DII net inflow of Rs 196.93 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for FOMC Meeting Minutes release tomorrow at 04:30 IST.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 continues upward trend with 0.38% gain.
Banking sector leads with over 1% rise.
FII inflows remain strong, boosting market sentiment.
